highlights.title: A little more room between chat lines
highlights.line: Messages in an agent conversation now have a little more space between lines.

highlights.title: The restart note says what was checked
highlights.line: After this computer restarts, the note says how many agents came back, names any that did not, and whether Kosmos's main records read fine.

highlights.title: A just-started agent gets your first message
highlights.line: On Windows, a message to an agent that has only just started waits a few seconds for it, or says it is still starting.

highlights.title: A closed task says how it closed
highlights.line: A closed task says whether it closed with a change, on a note, or without being marked built, on the Tasks list and on its page.

highlights.title: A paused room says why it stayed quiet
highlights.line: When a room's wake pause keeps a post from waking anyone, the reply says why the room is paused, who paused it, and what still gets through.
